Five reasons a lifelong Catholic still can't understand the Bible she owns:

1. The Bible changes genre without warning. Genesis reads like a story. Then Leviticus hits and it's priestly law and census lists. You didn't get worse at reading — the book changed on you, and nobody said so.

2. Footnotes explain verses, not books. A study Bible with ten thousand footnotes will define a word for you and never once tell you WHO a book was written to, or WHY.
